status: First bounded RPU evidence pass. Observed price anchors and conditional modeling recommendations, not a completed reference-RPU or incentive forecast.

KBB_DEC25.definition: USD average transaction price BEFORE applied consumer incentives; not manufacturer revenue; monthly mix-dependent estimate

COX_Q222.period: Q2 2022 with same-quarter historical incentive comparatives
COX_Q222.definition: Historical model ATP and brand incentive estimates. Old product mix; do not treat as 2025/26 reference net RPU. Verify exact historic ATP methodology before netting incentives.

IDAHO_JEEP.period: MY2026; effective/publication date not established from PDF
IDAHO_JEEP.definition: Young Automotive government procurement schedule: dealer-net invoice, destination, government bid assistance, dealer margin and final buyer cost. Not a representative retail transaction sample or fully reconciled OEM realization.

MGMT.locator: PDF pages 6-7, Goldman question and CFO answer
MGMT.definition: Management attributes part of group profit bridge to retained pricing already taken in NA; discusses neutral NA mix versus 2025 in 2028-30. Profit bridge statements, not an exact RPU growth forecast.

recommendations.retention_case: Conditionally hold comparable-product net price constant from a validated latest reference through 2027-28. This is a neutral scenario, not evidence that prices will be flat and not a zero cumulative change versus FY2025. Preserve separately evidenced carryover.
recommendations.incentives: Do not choose current brand incentive levels from 2022 numbers or government bid assistance. Current realized averages remain missing. Keep nominal pricing and incentive paths internally consistent with the selected net-price scenario.
recommendations.model_mix: Calculate automatically from volumes and reference relative prices; do not add discretionary mix growth. Within-model configuration mix remains an assumption without observed trim shares.
recommendations.new_models: Use launch-specific reference prices and explicit uncertainty, not historic discontinued-model prices. Aggregate Other/new rows need a weighted price reflecting their individual planned products.
recommendations.FX: USD evidence must be translated with an explicit period-appropriate exchange rate. Do not mix FX movements with real pricing or use spot FX for FY2025 actuals.
recommendations.calibration: Reconcile estimated model/country prices to regional net revenue with an explicit non-vehicle/scope residual. Do not call the calibration factor dealer margin or independently validated OEM prices.
recommendations.sensitivity: Illustrative +/-1000 EUR of incremental manufacturer support per affected shipment changes revenue by -/+1m EUR per 1000 affected units. Apply only to the relevant geography/brand shipment population. Pricing-only AOI passthrough requires an explicit assumption and exclusion of volume/cost responses.

limitations_and_stopping_rule: No current model sales-weighted trim mix or complete FY2025/2026 brand incentive panel recovered in this pass.
Do not use December-only brand ATP as full-year 2025 actual RPU.
Price schedules repeat some model codes and prices under multiple trim names; do not equally weight listed rows or assume every option package is priced.
